profile_text.body:
Apple is a public company founded in 1976 and headquartered in Cupertino, CA, that designs consumer hardware, software, and services. Its SEC filings list a CIK of 0000320193 and ticker AAPL, and the company reported revenue of $416,161,000,000 for the fiscal year ending September 27, 2025. The company describes its AI work as centered on privacy, with processing handled on-device using Apple silicon where possible.

Apple's primary AI product is Apple Intelligence, which the company describes as integrated into iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS Golden Gate, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27. Apple Intelligence powers a next-generation version of Siri that the site says supports open-ended questions, natural back-and-forth conversation, in-app actions across Messages, Music, Reminders, and other apps, on-screen visual queries, and AI-assisted writing and automation via Shortcuts. The company notes that Siri AI will launch in beta, in English first, and will not initially be available in the EU on iOS, iPadOS, or watchOS. The company also tracks AI capabilities in Final Cut Pro and iMovie, both described as using on-device processing consistent with its privacy-first positioning.

The held facts show 174 legal matters with California exposure and two MCP server entries: one for managing Apple Ads campaigns and reporting, and one providing Apple Developer Documentation with semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI reranking for MCP clients.
